line.comment: * Check if ship is still valid.
* We don't use Mayhem.BuildShipFromReserve because we want it unequipped and it's possible the ship has already been taken out from the reserve by the AI.
* Add-Ons 1.14: Moved to subroutine.
* Mission is accepted.
* Xenons are created when [PLAYERSHIP] goes to $sector, through !ship.signal.changesector.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Reworked Suppression mission. Player must assassinate a squadron leader.
* Don't create anymore asteroids if all of them are not already scanned.
* Pirates.
* Add-Ons 1.3: Added Yaki Buzzard, Tonbo, and Buster.
* Add-Ons 2.1.3: Delivery pirates now spawn from randomized positions within a 3D outer shell instead of four fixed corners.
* One randomized anchor position per pirate group.
* Spawn near existing debris, if available.
* Create and protect the abandoned bait ship.
* Insane mode doubles strength, a 33% increase compared to hard.
* Expanded 2.2: Damage the ship between 30-70% hull (was 40-70% starting in 1.6). Consistent with mission flavor.
